verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists "search across calls" as a product feature, so cross-meeting search is a documented first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence describes what that search covers (transcripts vs. summaries vs. notes) or whether results jump to the exact timestamp. Keyword alerts and topic monitoring are a related but different feature and are not credited. missing for 10: documentation that search spans transcripts, summaries and notes; jump-to-exact-moment (timestamp) navigation from results; any depth or hands-on corroboration of the search feature.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said
